'''Tate Jinja''' (建神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Tsurugi, Tokushima|en|Tsurugi, Tokushima|qid=Q1206005|lt=Tsurugi, Tokushima}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|en|Tokushima Prefecture|qid=Q160734|lt=Tokushima Prefecture}}.
== History ==
The year of its foundation is unknown. It is affectionately called Gongen-san or Gongen-han. According to one theory, it was once located in a place called Tenno in Handayama in ancient times.<ref>{{Cite web|和書|url=https://genbu.net/data/awa2/tate2_title.htm|title=建神社|publisher=玄松子の記憶|accessdate=2021-05-14}}</ref>
It is one of the candidate shrines identified as the Shikinaisha “Tate Jinja.”
== deity ==
* {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|ja|素盞嗚命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qid=Q272993}}
== Access ==
* About 10 minutes on foot from {{ill|Awa-Handa Station|en|Awa-Handa Station|qid=Q4829609|lt=Awa-Handa Station}} on the {{ill|Tokushima Line|en|Tokushima Line|qid=Q899310|lt=Tokushima Line}} of {{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|en|Shikoku Railway Company|qid=Q496531|lt=JR Shikoku}}.
